## Highlights

- Declare when advice is needed with `--stage manual|plan|pivot|final`; optionally skip locally
  classified trivial plan/final work with `--auto-skip-trivial`.
- Inspect task-free egress before execution with `--preview`, including selected vendors, delivery
  exposure, context, local probe count, and task-bearing child bound.
- Request an explicit two-to-four-vendor council with `--council`. Every member runs in a fresh
  independent process, partial results are preserved, and descriptive consensus/dissent never
  selects a winner or claims quality verification.
- Select the smallest useful context with `--context task|diff|files|repo`. Diff context is a
  bounded tracked `HEAD` diff; files context uses repeated explicit `--file` paths.
- Review findings now receive snapshot-bound local `file:line` triage and invocation-only exact
  duplicate grouping. Human output folds rejected/duplicate findings while JSON retains every
  original finding and annotation.
- Install advisory Agent Skill onboarding generation 16 with the new one-shot timing, context,
  preview, and explicit-council guidance.

## Compatibility and safety

The single-vendor `ask --vendor ...` path, `manual` stage, and `repo` context remain the defaults.
Council routing is never automatic and cross-vendor consent cannot be inferred from risk or
complexity. Call budgets are per invocation and no task-derived state, semantic key, result, or
context is persisted.

Preview reads neither task stdin nor repository content and starts no vendor process. Real runs
still perform two task-free local CLI probes per vendor before task input. A council contains at
most four task-bearing children, runs them sequentially in requested order, and exits 2 with a
machine-readable partial receipt when a member fails.

Explicit file context rejects traversal, every `.git` component, symlinks, controls, binary or
non-UTF-8 content, files over 32 KiB, and aggregates over 128 KiB. File bytes and local triage are
bound to the pre-execution snapshot. Diff context resolves and observes an absolute
non-repository Git executable before stdin, binds `--git-dir` and `--work-tree` to a standard
repository, disables external diff, text conversion, color, hooks, fsmonitor, and optional locks,
and omits untracked files. Linked-worktree `.git` files fail closed for this narrow selector.

The tool still does not confine a selected CLI from the host filesystem, verify provider recipient
or billing, or check top-level Git metadata. Agy task/context delivery remains visible in local
process arguments and is disclosed before execution. Every model-authored result and local
consensus label remains explicitly untrusted and `quality_verified:false`.

Two scrubbed GLM reviews used public packets of 81,943 and 87,976 bytes (SHA-256 prefixes
`e7c87f987906` and `344e43c60f56`). Confirmed consent, Git/worktree binding, executable-path,
snapshot-race, aggregate-I/O, finding-mute, prompt-boundary, citation, partial-receipt, and argv
disclosure issues were fixed and retested. A complete nine-production-file Codex Security diff
review retained no finding; TAC status was not queried. Full validation passed 1,563 tests with 35
skips, Ruff check and format-check over 205 files, strict mypy over 202 source files, compileall,
and the full Python 3.10-3.14 plus macOS Python 3.10/3.14 PR matrix.

## Installation

```sh
uv tool install --upgrade "weightclass==0.28.0"
brew upgrade ictechgy/tap/weightclass
```
